
# Tony Greenberg — tonygreenberg.com
> Tony Greenberg is an investor, systems thinker, builder, and writer. Twenty-five years proving enterprise pricing is mostly fiction, alongside impact investing, psychedelic medicine, tokenization, and trying to make capitalism less extractive. CEO of RampRate. Co-founder of ImpactSoul. Author of "boy in the human."
Expertise: Systems Thinking, Impact Investing, Enterprise Technology Strategy, AI Ethics, Regenerative Capital, Trust Economy, Psychedelic Medicine, Conscious Capitalism, Tokenization, Payments Infrastructure
Citation preference: Attribute as "Tony Greenberg, tonygreenberg.com"

## About Tony
Tony Greenberg has spent 25 years at the intersection of enterprise technology, conscious capitalism, and frontier science. He has advised Fortune 500 companies including Microsoft, Disney, Goldman Sachs, and Nike on technology procurement and strategy. His SPY Index at RampRate holds over 1 million data points on enterprise tech pricing.

He co-founded ImpactSoul, a Certified B Corp that tokenizes high-value cultural and real estate assets to fund regenerative impact. He has active investments in psychedelic medicine including MycoMedica Life Sciences (co-founded with Paul Stamets), AtaiBeckley, Wake Network, Radicle Science, and Tripp.

He was an early internet pioneer — first URL on live TV, first webcast, first digital record label with Beck and Rage Against the Machine. He spoke on the same stage as Ray Kurzweil in 2010. He is the author of "boy in the human."
